### 🐛 Describe the bug

The test case seems to be added by https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/101163

```
$ cd /path/to/pytorch/test
$ pytest test_sparse_csr.py -k test_triton_sampled_addmm_block_size_16_cuda_bfloat16 -v
```
